html_bullets.point: Bajaj Auto Limited will hold a conference call for analysts and institutional investors on May 29, 2025, at 07:00 PM IST to discuss its Q4 FY25 results. Details for participation are provided in the announcement.
Bajaj Auto reported a 17.6% decline in electric two-wheeler (e2W) sales in April, attributed to the subsidy reduction. This contributed to the overall downturn in the segment.
Despite challenges in the e2W segment, Bajaj Auto recorded a 4.1% growth in electric three-wheeler (e3W) sales in April.
